holdout.reason: Known synthetic basic preview checks only. No generalization, final core adoption, or comparative superiority claim.

independence.reason: Answer generation and grading were separate from implementation. Generators received target skills and prompts, not the frozen rubric or expected outputs. The reviewer saw rubric, answers and implementation diff, so this is independent but not blind comparative grading. Full generation trace was not independently audited.

input_boundary.side_effects: 合成回答の生成・記録のみ。実API・実機操作・plugin導入はなし。

execution.scope: Answer-level basic checks only. Source prompts and protocol were frozen before generation; no app, API or installed discovery was executed.

evidence.grading: All conjunctions in each frozen case are represented as one critical case requirement. No new criterion was introduced after the run. Detailed observations remain in local evaluation storage.

limitations: Cases are grouped in two generation contexts, not isolated per case.
Criteria version 1.0.0 denotes this basic PROTOCOL v1; no complete communication-quality-v2 evaluation is claimed.
Blind comparison and independent full trace auditing were not performed.

decision.scope: Continue as optional preview only; real use and A/B/C comparison remain separate.

結果不明では再送せず読取照合。反映遅延と冪等性を区別し、未確定なら照会へ戻す。実API呼出しなし。
下書き完成と利用可能を分け、版・アクセス・未完了・再開点を確認。未許可の送信や受領・理解の断定なし。
指定された誤字だけを修正。計画・状態表・確認待ちを増やさない。
previewなしで、入力世代による新旧応答・成功失敗の反映境界と確認方法を設計。実装済みとはしない。
